[[File:SeaSickRodian.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] feeling ill on a rocking boat.]]
{{Quote|On a ship this big you don't always feel motion. It's designed that way, to keep the passengers from getting motion sickness.|[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]]|<ref name="gof10">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Doomsday Ship]]''</ref>}}
'''Motion sickness''', also called '''"sea-sickness"''', was a condition that caused nausea and was often aggravated by repetitive motion, such as the rocking of a ship at sea. Many large [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as ''[[Star of Empire]]'' were designed to dampen motion to prevent passengers from getting this condition.<ref name="gof10" />

The [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] criminal [[Jasper]] was known to suffer from this condition.<ref name="TopWorld">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: TopWorld}}</ref> The idea of [[Fian/Legends|Fian]] cities on [[Galantos]] sitting atop gelatin seas made [[Tahiri Veila]] motion sick.<ref name="fh1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref> Due to their arboreal lifestyle, the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Noehon]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were resistant to the affects of motion sickness.<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

[[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] once complained of nausea when on a spaceship with the artificial gravity turned off.<ref>''[[Ewoks (television series)]]'', "[[Battle for the Sunstar]]"</ref>
